description: Source code for MainActivity in an Android app demonstrating multiwindow features, including activity launching with various flags, bounds, and configuration handling.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main entry point activity providing UI to launch other activities with specific window and configuration options.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets layout, and updates UI based on multiwindow mode.

methods.name: onStartUnresizableClick
methods.description: Handles click to start UnresizableActivity with the FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK flag.

methods.name: onStartAdjacentActivity
methods.description: Handles click to start AdjacentActivity with flags to suggest adjacent placement and new task.

methods.name: onStartLaunchBoundsActivity
methods.description: Handles click to start LaunchBoundsActivity with specified launch bounds via ActivityOptions.

methods.name: onStartBasicActivity
methods.description: Handles click to start BasicActivity with default launch mode.

methods.name: onStartCustomConfigurationActivity
methods.description: Handles click to start CustomConfigurationChangeActivity which handles its own configuration changes.
